snippet.title: Drop Duchy - The North - PC Gameplay
snippet.description:
About The Game
In The North, the second DLC for Drop Duchy, you will fight in battles inspired by warring Vikings. Build new tactics for all game modes, with aggressive new combat and looting mechanics.

Release Date:5 Dec, 2025
Developer:Sleepy Mill Studio
Publisher:The Arcade Crew

Drop Duchy - The North ans of the Past Steam/GOG/itch.io/Epic Games

PC Specs:
CPU:  Intel Core i5-12600K 
GPU:  MSI RTX 5060 8GB Ventus 2X OC White GDDR7
RAM: 32GB (16GBx2) DDR5 6000MHz CL38 TeamGroup T-Force Delta RGB 
MOBO: MSI PRO Z790-P WIFI
Monitor: Gigabyte G24F 2 Gaming
